subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: Source proves direct inbound text extraction is missing, but the issue also asks for form/select/button callback data whose JSON/text shape is an agent-visible channel behavior and compatibility choice.

options.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
options.body: Keep this broad tracker open, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the linked callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload contracts.

options.title: Reduce to direct inbound only
options.body: Retitle or split this issue so it covers only `message_type: "interactive"` parsing and leaves card actions and merge_forward behavior to existing linked issues.

options.title: Defer rich payloads
options.body: Pause broad form/select/card payload exposure if maintainers want Feishu card interactions to stay command/text-only for now.

recommendation.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this broad tracker open, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the linked callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark community-maintained plugin contact for the affected channel.
